query: Which robust-training methods (EM/latent-variable, noise-aware loss, seed high-quality subset, semi-supervised) are most effective for POS labels with realistic annotation noise?

response.query: Which robust-training methods (EM/latent-variable, noise-aware loss, seed high-quality subset, semi-supervised) are most effective for POS labels with realistic annotation noise?
response.answer: For POS labels with realistic annotation noise, semi-supervised learning and noise-aware loss methods are most effective. They leverage both labeled and unlabeled data to improve robustness. Seeding with high-quality subsets also helps in initial training.
